definitions.explanation: The loosening or removal of government rules on business or other activity, usually to encourage competition and growth. A standard term in economic and political news.

examples.japanese: {規制緩和|きせいかんわ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦タクシー→タクシー：00816_takushii⟧⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{規制緩和|きせいかんわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: The government decided to deregulate the taxi industry.

examples.japanese: {規制緩和|きせいかんわ}⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{次々|つぎつぎ}→次々：03522_tsugitsugi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参入|さんにゅう}→参入：09939_sannyuu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to deregulation, new companies entered the market one after another.

notes:
⟦{規制|きせい}→規制：02598_kisei⟧ (regulation) + ⟦{緩和|かんわ}→緩和：13846_kanwa⟧ (easing). The opposite direction is {規制強化|きせいきょうか} (tightening of regulations).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {規制緩和|きせいかんわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}める→進める：01949_susumeru⟧: to push ahead with deregulation
- {規制緩和|きせいかんわ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧: deregulation advances
- ⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧な{規制緩和|きせいかんわ}: sweeping deregulation
- {規制緩和|きせいかんわ}⟦{策|さく}→策：09997_saku⟧: deregulation measures
